raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Follow-up to the async device->host readback worker for NVIDIA Confidential Computing (CC). Two things it left on the table:

1. **Host staging stayed pinned.** Under CC host<->device copies go through a bounce buffer; this change selects pageable staging there through `is_pin_memory_available()`.
2. **Two batch kinds must not take the worker.** Batches that return hidden states, and DSpark batches, read views of CUDA graph buffers that the next replay rewrites. Only a copy queued right behind the forward on `copy_stream` reads them in time; a copy issued later from the worker thread can race the next replay.

## Modifications

- `is_pin_memory_available()` answers `False` under CC. `async_d2h()` already falls back to a pageable copy when it does, so the overlap scheduler's readback buffers and every other staged copy are pageable there. Off CC nothing changes: staging stays pinned.
- Both scheduler submit sites (`run_batch` and `launch_batch_sample_if_needed`) go through one `_copy_result_to_cpu` helper. Under CC it hands the readback to the worker unless the batch returns hidden states or runs DSpark; those stay inline on `copy_stream`, as before the worker existed.
- The prefill result-polling scheduler fake borrows the helper, as it already borrows `launch_batch_sample_if_needed`.

## Tests

`test/registered/unit/managers/test_async_d2h_copy_worker.py` gains two cases:

- `TestConfidentialComputeStaging`: `async_d2h` lands in pageable memory with the force override on and pinned memory with it off.
- `TestSchedulerReadbackRouting`: the source tensor is written behind a long `torch.cuda._sleep`, so a readback that does not wait for the forward reads zeros. Under CC only the plain batch gets a `HostCopyDone`; hidden-state and DSpark batches keep a CUDA event, and every host buffer is pageable. Each case was verified to fail with the corresponding branch removed.

Ran on a single GPU: the whole file (8 tests) and `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_result_polling.py` (20 tests) pass; `ruff`, `ruff format`, `isort` and `codespell` are clean with the repository's configuration. No CC host was available, so the behaviour under real CC was not measured here.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+    def _copy_result_to_cpu(
+        self, batch_result: GenerationBatchResult, batch: ScheduleBatch
+    ) -> None:
+        """Issue the result readback on copy_stream so it overlaps the next forward.
+
+        copy_stream is a leaf gated by copy_done that forward_stream never waits
+        for. Under Confidential Computing the copy would block this thread until
+        the forward is done, so the worker issues it from its own thread instead.
+        """
+        copy_fn = partial(
+            batch_result.copy_to_cpu,
+            return_logprob=batch.return_logprob,
+            return_hidden_states=batch.return_hidden_states,
+        )
+        self.copy_stream.wait_stream(self.forward_stream)
+        with self.copy_stream_ctx:
+            if not self.enable_async_d2h_copy:
+                copy_fn()
+            elif batch.return_hidden_states or batch.spec_algorithm.is_dspark():
+                # Hidden states and the DSpark accept lengths are views of CUDA
+                # graph buffers that the next replay rewrites; only a copy queued
+                # right behind this forward reads them in time.
+                copy_fn()
+            else:
+                batch_result.copy_done = self.async_d2h_worker.submit(copy_fn)

@@ -12,12 +12,17 @@
 """
 
 import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
 
 import torch
 
 from sglang.srt.environ import envs
-from sglang.srt.managers.async_d2h_copy_worker import AsyncD2HCopyWorker
-from sglang.srt.utils.common import is_confidential_compute
+from sglang.srt.managers.async_d2h_copy_worker import AsyncD2HCopyWorker, HostCopyDone
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import (
+    async_d2h,
+    is_confidential_compute,
+    is_pin_memory_available,
+)
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
@@ -113,5 +118,107 @@ def test_env_override_false(self):
         is_confidential_compute.cache_clear()
 
 
+SLEEP_CYCLES = 200_000_000  # ~100ms at 2GHz; outlives the handoff to the worker
+
+
+def _late_source(value: int, numel: int = 4) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A device tensor that holds ``value`` only after a long kernel on this stream."""
+    src = torch.zeros(numel, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+    torch.cuda._sleep(SLEEP_CYCLES)
+    return src.fill_(value)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "pinned host memory requires CUDA")
+class TestConfidentialComputeStaging(CustomTestCase):
+    """Host staging is pageable under CC and pinned otherwise."""
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        is_confidential_compute.cache_clear()
+        self.addCleanup(is_confidential_compute.cache_clear)
+
+    def test_async_d2h_stages_pageable_under_cc(self):
+        src = torch.arange(4, device="cuda")
+        for cc in (False, True):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(cc=cc),
+                envs.SGLANG_FORCE_CONFIDENTIAL_COMPUTE.override(cc),
+            ):
+                is_confidential_compute.cache_clear()
+                self.assertEqual(is_pin_memory_available(src.device), not cc)
+                host = async_d2h(src)
+                torch.cuda.current_stream().synchronize()
+                self.assertEqual(host.is_pinned(), not cc)
+                self.assertEqual(host.tolist(), [0, 1, 2, 3])
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "the scheduler readback requires CUDA")
+class TestSchedulerReadbackRouting(CustomTestCase):
+    """Every readback path must wait for the forward: a copy issued too early reads
+    the zeros the source held before it. Under CC only plain batches take the
+    worker; hidden-state and DSpark batches stay inline, since they read CUDA
+    graph buffers that the next replay rewrites."""
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        is_confidential_compute.cache_clear()
+        self.addCleanup(is_confidential_compute.cache_clear)
+        self.worker = AsyncD2HCopyWorker(torch.cuda)
+        self.addCleanup(self.worker.shutdown)
+
+    def _readback(self, cc: bool, hidden: bool, dspark: bool):
+        from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+        from sglang.srt.managers.utils import GenerationBatchResult
+        from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpeculativeAlgorithm
+
+        forward_stream, copy_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(), torch.cuda.Stream()
+        scheduler = SimpleNamespace(
+            forward_stream=forward_stream,
+            copy_stream=copy_stream,
+            copy_stream_ctx=torch.cuda.stream(copy_stream),
+            enable_async_d2h_copy=cc,
+            async_d2h_worker=self.worker if cc else None,
+        )
+        # Distinct per case, so a reused host block cannot pass a stale value.
+        value = 7 + cc + hidden + 2 * dspark
+        with torch.cuda.stream(forward_stream):
+            ids = _late_source(value, numel=1 << 24)  # 128 MiB: the copy takes a while
+            logits = SimpleNamespace(
+                hidden_states=_late_source(value) if hidden else None,
+                sampling_mask_output=None,
+                auxiliary_device_output=None,
+            )
+            result = GenerationBatchResult(
+                logits_output=logits, next_token_ids=ids, copy_done=torch.cuda.Event()
+            )
+        algorithm = SpeculativeAlgorithm.DSPARK if dspark else SpeculativeAlgorithm.NONE
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            return_logprob=False, return_hidden_states=hidden, spec_algorithm=algorithm
+        )
+        with envs.SGLANG_FORCE_CONFIDENTIAL_COMPUTE.override(cc):
+            is_confidential_compute.cache_clear()
+            Scheduler._copy_result_to_cpu(scheduler, result, batch)
+            result.copy_done.synchronize()
+        return result, logits.hidden_states, value
+
+    def test_readback_lands_after_the_forward(self):
+        cases = {
+            "off-inline": (False, False, False),
+            "cc-worker": (True, False, False),
+            "cc-hidden-states-inline": (True, True, False),
+            "cc-dspark-inline": (True, False, True),
+        }
+        for name, (cc, hidden, dspark) in cases.items():
+            with self.subTest(name):
+                result, hidden_states, value = self._readback(cc, hidden, dspark)
+                offloaded = cc and not (hidden or dspark)
+                self.assertEqual(isinstance(result.copy_done, HostCopyDone), offloaded)
+                for host in (result.next_token_ids, hidden_states):
+                    if host is None:
+                        continue
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        (host.device.type, host.is_pinned()), ("cpu", not cc)
+                    )
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(host, torch.full_like(host, value)))
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
